name: Sandra Turis
source:
Detective Sandra Turis was destined to become a police officer. Her father was gunned down in a mob-related alcohol bust when Sandra was just 7. The failed bust was blamed on corruption at the precinct, and more specifically on Sandra's dad and his partner. Sandra has made it her career goal to exonerate her father. Not an easy task as most of the participants of the bust are now dead. Sandra is perceptive, assertive, and passionate.

[Edited from in-game description]
